chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Is'haq ibn Jareer who said:
A woman from us asked me to introduce her to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him). So I sought permission for her, and he granted it. She entered, and with her was her slave girl.
She said to him, 'O Abu Abdullah! Regarding the Words of the Exalted: "an olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west," what is meant by this?'
He said to her, 'O woman! Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not strike the example for the tree; rather, He struck the example for the children of Adam. Ask about whatever you intend.'
She said, 'Inform me about the lesbian with the lesbian; what is their legal punishment (hadd) in it?'

He said, 'The legal punishment (hadd) is that of adultery. Indeed, on the Day of Judgment, they will be brought, and they will be clothed in cut-outs of fire, harnessed with fire-harnesses, and dressed in fire. Columns of fire will enter their bellies up to their heads, and they will be thrown into the Fire.'

'O woman! The first people to perform this deed were the people of Lot. The men satisfied their needs with men, so the women remained without men, and so they did as their men did, satisfying each other.'
She said to him, 'May Allah keep you well! What do you say regarding the woman who menstruates, and the days of her menstruation exceed the limit?'
He said, 'If her menstruation is less than ten days, she examines after one day, then she is considered one with inter-period bleeding (istihada).'
She said, 'Supposing the blood continues with her for the month, and the two months, and three months, how does she deal with the prayer?'
He said, 'She sits for the days of her menstruation, then she performs the ritual bath (ghusl) for every two prayers.'
She said to him, 'Indeed, the days of her menstruation vary for her. The menstruation might precede by a day, or two days, or three, and delay similarly. How does she know it?'
He said, 'The blood of menstruation is not obscure. It is hot blood; you find a burning sensation with it. And the blood of inter-period bleeding is putrid, cold.'

key_terms.اسْتِحَاضَة: Inter-period bleeding (irregular bleeding outside of menses)

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq distinguish between menstrual blood and istihada blood, and what is the ruling for women with irregular menstruation?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi illustrates the Imam’s method of addressing diverse inquiries, linking Quranic exegesis, legal rulings (hadd), and practical fiqh. It highlights the Shia jurisprudential distinction between hayd and istihada based on the physical quality of the blood (heat vs. coldness), which determines the obligation of ghusl for each prayer. The narrative also connects the origin of female homosexuality to the story of Lot, providing a theological context for the specific punishment described.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Is’haq Bin Jareer who said,
‘A woman from us asked me if I could get her to see Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>. So I sought the permission for her and he<sup>asws</sup> permitted for her, and with her was a slave girl of hers.
So she said to him, ‘O Abu Abdullahasws! The Words of the Exalted, [24:35] lit from a blessed olive-tree, neither eastern nor western, what is Meant by this?’

So he<sup>asws</sup> said to her: ‘O you woman! Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Exalted does not Strike the examples for the trees. But rather, He<sup>azwj</sup> struck examples for the children of Adam<sup>as</sup>. Ask about whatever you are intending to’.
She said, ‘Inform me about the lesbian with the lesbian, what are their legal punishments (Hadd)?’

Heasws said: ‘The legal punishment (Hadd) of the adultery. When it will be the Day of Judgement, they will come with them, and they would be wearing cut-outs of Fire, and harnessed by the harnesses of Fire, and wearing trousers of Fire, and columns of Fire would enter inside them to go up to their heads, and they will be thrown into the Fire.

O you woman! The first ones who did this deed were the people of Lot<sup>as</sup>, and the men satisfied their needs with the men. So the women remained without men, and so they did just as their men were doing, satisfying each other’.
So she said to himasws, ‘May Allahazwj Keep youasws well! What are youasws saying regarding the woman who menstruates and it exceeds the (regular) days of her menstruation (Haydh)?’
Heasws said: ‘If her menstruation (Haydh) was of less than ten days, she would examine after one day, then she would be with inter-period bleeding (Istihaaza)’.
She said, ‘Supposing the blood continues with her for the month and the two months, and the three, how would she deal with the Salaat?’
Heasws said: ‘She would sit (awaiting) for the (regular) days of her menstruation (Haydh), then she would wash for every two Salaats’.

So she said to himasws, ‘If the days of her menstruation (Haydh) are different upon her, and the menstruation (Haydh) tended to precede by the day, or two days, and three, and it would get delayed similar to that, so what can she know with it?’

Heasws said: ‘The blood of the menstruation (Haydh) is not unknown. It is a hot blood. You would find a burning sensation with it. And the blood of the inter-period bleeding (Istihaaza) is putrid, cold’.
